name: llmproxy
description: Standalone GitHub Copilot proxy CLI with native service management

0.2.60: embed current release notes in the installed package for first-update compatibility
keep deriving update changelogs from the release commit message when available
preserve hardcoded release notes only as a backward-compatible final fallback
0.2.61: stabilize launchd service restart by avoiding explicit stop before kickstart on macOS
treat missing launchd bootout targets as already stopped during service recovery
cap forwarded Copilot tools to 128 on both /responses and /chat/completions
make claude:setup and model:set target the installed llmproxy service port when LLMPROXY_HOME is set
0.2.62: add explicit vision capability for providers with --vision flag in provider:add and provider:key
implement automatic fallback skip for non-vision providers when requests contain images
add provider:test command to verify vision capability of all configured providers
add reasoning_content support for Kimi and other thinking models
add qwen3.7-plus, deepseek-v4-pro, kimi-k2.6 to model-capabilities registry
0.2.63: support multiple instances of the same provider with different models via provider:add
fix update-service.sh: use docker-compose.production.yml and set LLMPROXY_HOME when missing
fix update-service.sh: graceful skip when Docker Compose is not installed
